chunks: A man asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
so he said: 'I am a goldsmith working with my hands, and there gathers in my possession five and ten (items). Is there zakat on it?'
He said: 'When two hundred dirhams have accumulated and a year has passed over them, then indeed the zakat is due upon them.'

key_terms.الْحَوْلُ: The hawl — the passage of one complete lunar year while possessing the nisab amount
key_terms.الْخَمْسَةُ وَ الْعَشَرَةُ: The five and the ten — small quantities of items or dirhams accumulated in trade
key_terms.زَكَاة: Zakat — the obligatory alms-tax, one of the pillars of Islam
key_terms.صَائِغ: Goldsmith or silversmith — a craftsman who works with precious metals
key_terms.مِائَتَا دِرْهَمٍ: Two hundred dirhams — the nisab (minimum threshold) for zakat on silver

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount (nisab) of silver required for zakat according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: A goldsmith inquires of Imam al-Sadiq (AS) whether the small amounts of silver he accumulates through his craft are subject to zakat. The Imam establishes the nisab (minimum threshold) of 200 dirhams and the condition of hawal al-hawl (the passage of one full lunar year) as the two prerequisites for zakat becoming obligatory on silver. This is a foundational ruling in Shia fiqh on zakat al-nuqud (zakat on money/precious metals).
